review.method: Acceptance suite run locally with the retail capability; this harness derives every field from the recorded log, production discovery of $CS_GAME_DIR, and a second production run of cs_app::objectives::survey_retail_objective_records over the installation (count-category-census.json). Claim is implemented only. MEASURED: every mission-scoped reader archive was opened, its objectives.zrd member decoded with the production .zrd reader, its numbered OBJECTIVE<N> blocks walked, and the archive's targets.zrd decoded where it declares one; over 53 mission readers the installation declares 1338 objective blocks, 1335 counted-condition stages in 129 thresholded blocks beside 130 completion-count thresholds, 327 target records of which 289 carry an objective kind; 52 of the mission readers declare no targets.zrd member at all (zbd/c1c/m01), so the two surfaces have different denominators and neither was widened to the other. The per-category evidence over the whole published vocabulary: destroyed: 107 sites (MSG_OBJ_DESTROY 107); disabled: 13 sites (MSG_OBJ_DISABLE 5, MSG_OBJ_DISABLEENG 8); captured: 0 sites; escaped: 0 sites; despawned: 0 sites. The missions carrying a disable declaration: zbd/c1/ia1 1, zbd/c1b/ia1 1, zbd/c1b/m03 1, zbd/c1c/ia1 1, zbd/c2/ia1 1, zbd/c2b/ia1 1, zbd/c3/ia1 1, zbd/c4/ia1 1, zbd/c5/ia1 1, zbd/c5/m03 4. LIMITS OF WHAT WAS MEASURED, each recorded in docs/findings/2026-10-04-f39-e4-count-category-producers.md: (1) what the corpus DECLARES is measured, and what any declaration DOES is not - the record is not the program and the mission-language instruction table is unmeasured (F13-B/C, F38 own it); (2) a localized objective kind is a label, not a counted lifecycle transition, so MSG_OBJ_DISABLE is not a producer for a disabled count; (3) the counted conditions' third name is a part-state spelling whose semantics are unmeasured - the original's own recording of a disabled airframe is not recovered; (4) no original executable was run, so nothing here is evidence of behaviour, only of what the files declare. Because no measured producer exists for a disabled or escaped count, an original record is refused by name when it counts one, so no original mission is played and this report claims no original behaviour. `unknowns` is empty because every unresolved item above is a limit on the claim rather than an unresolved measurement: every row in the census resolved. Validated with tools/validate_evidence.py --require-pass.
